games.name: Rectangles
games.summary: Divide the grid into rectangles, each holding one number: its area.

games.name: Slanted
games.summary: Draw a diagonal in every square, touching each number that many times, without loops.

games.name: Light Up
games.summary: Place lights until every white square is lit, without any shining on another.

games.name: Unruly
games.summary: Make every square black or white: no three alike side by side, each row and column half and half.
